title: Per-endpoint SLI probe harness and quality-gating for regional drain
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define and implement a lightweight synthetic probe harness and SLI signature per model endpoint that captures both system health (latency/availability) and model output quality, and wire quality-aware gates into the regional drain and circuit-breaker choreography. Goal: make multi-region failover and load-shedding decisions driven by measured request fidelity, not only infra health, to reduce customer-visible regressions during degradations.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Per-endpoint probe harness deployed in staging and prod that emits latency P50/P95/P99, availability, prefix-KV hit-rate, and a quality-score metric (0-100) computed over canonical prompt sets. 2) Dashboard and alerting for each metric with clear owners. 3) Automated gating in the regional drain controller: if quality_score < 80 for >5m or quality burn rate > 2x baseline, route 50% traffic to warm standby and trigger SRE runbook. 4) Circuit-breaker config updated to include quality_score thresholds and hysteresis. 5) Runbook and playbook written and reviewed by PM and SRE.
implementation_notes: Probe harness will be a lightweight service that issues canonical prompts to endpoints at a controlled cadence (configurable per endpoint). Quality scoring uses a simple rubric: exact-match for structured outputs, BLEU/ROUGE-like match for short completions, and a hallucination heuristic for knowledge queries using reference traces. Instrumentation will emit metrics to metrics-prod with tag keys: endpoint, model_version, region, intent_tier. KV-cache impact measured by spike tests (cold vs warm). Use existing runtime tracing hooks and extend exporter to add quality_score metric. Circuit-breaker additions will be implemented in traffic-router service (route-manager).
test_plan:
- Unit tests for probe scoring logic (target 90% coverage).
- Staging canary: 48h run against synthetic traffic plus 2 customer-like workloads.
- Fault injection: simulate regional CPU/GPU pressure and a model weight regression (mock degraded model) to validate that quality-aware gating triggers and that traffic shifts respect error-budget policies.
- Backfill historical telemetry for last 90d to calibrate baseline quality_score and burn rates.
- Postmortem template ready for any trigger during canary.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge small alpha probe into staging (week 1). 2) Run 48h synthetic canary and calibrate thresholds (week 2). 3) Enable quality-score gating in a single non-critical region for a low-traffic endpoint (week 3). 4) Gradual ramp to all endpoints with per-endpoint thresholds (weeks 4-5). 5) Post-rollout audit and threshold tuning (week 6).
